sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Gupta,Badri Prasad Singh,Nitin Padmesh Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Notices have been served on the respondents but none has appeared before the Court.
Heard learned counsel for the accused-applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been filed seeking release of accused/applicant Manish Kumar for grant of bail, who is involved in Case Crime No. 213 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Rampur Kalan, District Sitapur.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the prosecutrix was married to Ashish Kumar Singh, son of Braj Bhushan in the Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojna on 19.06.2022, marriage certificate of the same is annexed on record.

He further submitted that the prosecutrix, in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has admitted that she was in love with the applicant and out of love, she had gone with the applicant to Lucknow and lived there for 15 days.

Learned counsel further submitted that the it is a case of consent as the prosecutrix was already married and out of love she had gone along with him.
As per school certificate, the age of the prosecutrix is 17 years one month and ten days.

Learned counsel further submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case and it is the prosecutrix who had enticed the applicant because she was already married to one Ashish in Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana.
The prosecutrix denied to undergo medical examination.
Statement of the prosecutrix does not support the prosecution case.
There is no criminal history against the applicant and he is in jail since 20.08.2022.

Learned A.G.A. has, however, opposed the prayer for grant of bail and has submitted that the applicant does not deserve mercy of the Court and thus, the bail application of the applicant is liable to be rejected.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, perusing the record, considering the nature of allegations, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C which indicates that it is a case of consent as the prosecutrix was already married to Ashish in Mukhamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicant Manish Kumar involved in above-mentioned case be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not communicate with any of the prosecution witness including the informant and the violation of this condition alone shall be a sufficient ground for the trial court to cancel the facility of bail granted to the applicant.
(ii) Applicant shall not take adjournment on any of the date on which the prosecution witness(s) are in attendance and in this regard shall file an undertaking before the trial court.
(iii) If in case of any exigency/urgency the applicant is not able to appear before the trial court he shall instruct his counsel engaged in the trial court to do all required for early disposal of the case including the cross examination of any prosecution witness.
(iv) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(v) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.

sentences.text: (vi) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
